en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 4. My father narrated to me from Ḥusain ibn Ḥasan ibn Abān, from Muḥammad ibn Ūramah, from Abī ‘Abdillāh Al-Mu`min, from Ibn Muskān, from Sulaymān ibn Khālid, who said:

I heard Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) say: Verily every day and every night Allāh glances at the earth one hundred thousand times through which He forgives whomever He wills and punishes whomever He wills. Allāh specifically forgives those who go to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.), their family members, and those for whom they (the Zuwwār of Ḥusain (a.s.)) will intercede on the Day of Judgment, regardless of who they may be, even if they are among those upon whom Hell is made obligatory. I asked, “Even if they are among those upon whom Hell is made obligatory?” Imam (a.s.) replied, “Yes, as long as they are not NĀSIBǏ.”
